name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after a mechanical engineering degree. While working on industrial robotics, a chance encounter with a local racing team needing engine diagnostics led him to discover his true passion. He quickly transitioned from diagnostics to engine development, showcasing an innate ability to identify and resolve complex mechanical issues. His meticulous approach and talent for optimizing engine performance caught the eye of several teams, leading him to join Team Gtechniq as Chief Engineer.

As Chief Engineer, Jae-Hyun leads his team with a calm and pragmatic demeanor. He prioritizes data-driven decisions and fosters a collaborative environment, encouraging junior engineers to experiment and learn from their mistakes. His experience in both academic and practical settings allows him to bridge the gap between theory and application, making him an invaluable asset to the team. His colleagues value his reliability and unflappable nature, especially during high-pressure situations.

What sets Jae-Hyun apart is his relentless pursuit of efficiency. He believes that even the smallest improvements can lead to significant performance gains, a philosophy he instills in every member of his team. He is a master of identifying bottlenecks and streamlining processes, always seeking to optimize the car's performance without compromising its reliability.
